prompt: On Settings › Notifications (app/components/settings/NotificationsForm.vue), add a "Pause all notifications" switch at the top of the form. While it is on, every other option of the form is disabled and a note says "Notifications are paused"; turning it off restores them as they were. The pause is saved with the rest of the form.

constraints.text: Built on the app's existing Switch, form fields and Alert or text styles, as the other options are.
No colour, size or spacing typed by hand: the theme's tokens and Tailwind's scale only.
Off, on with the options disabled, in the dark theme and in a narrow window.
The switch has its label and says its state; disabled options are announced as disabled; the note is announced.
Only the notifications form changes; the other settings pages are unchanged, and no test is removed.

states.name: paused-dark
states.description: The same, in the dark theme.

states.name: narrow
states.description: The form in a phone-sized window.

acceptance.name: pausing shows the note, and resuming hides it
